we have identified miR‐22 to be an estrogen receptor α suppresser and that it is frequently downregulated in estrogen α receptor‐positive human breast cancers.

miR‐222, a miRNA that targets estrogen receptor α, was frequently downregulated and inversely correlated with estrogen receptor α protein expression in estrogen receptor α–positive human breast cancer.
miR‐ 22 is downregulated in ER‐positive human breast cancers and can regulate ERα expression.
